source_text: Example 1
target_text: Contoh 1

source_text: Consider the vector field $latex \vec F(x,y) = e^x \vec \imath + e^y \vec \jmath$. Let $latex \mathcal C$ be the part of the ellipse $latex x^2+4 y^2 = 4$, joining $latex (0,1)$ to $latex (2,0)$ in the clockwise direction. A parametrization of $latex \mathcal C$ is $latex x = 2 \sin(t)$, $latex y=\cos(t)$, with $latex t$ varying between 0 and $latex \pi/2$. Therefore,
target_text: Perhatikan medan vektor $latex \vec F(x,y) = e^x \vec \imath + e^y \vec \jmath$. Misalkan $latex \mathcal C$ merupakan bagian elips $latex x^2+4 y^2 = 4$ yang menghubungkan $latex (0,1)$ ke $latex (2,0)$ searah jarum jam. Suatu parametrisasi $latex \mathcal C$ adalah $latex x = 2 \sin(t)$, $latex y=\cos(t)$, dengan $latex t$ bervariasi antara 0 dan $latex \pi/2$. Oleh karena itu,

source_text: $latex \begin{align*} \int_{\mathcal C} \vec F \cdot d\vec r & = \int_0^{\pi/2} \left[e^{2 \sin(t)} \vec \imath + e^{\cos(t)} \vec \jmath \right] \cdot \left[2 \cos(t) \vec \imath - \sin(t) \vec \jmath \right] dt \\ & = \int_0^{\pi/2} \left[2 \cos(t) e^{2 \sin(t)} - \sin(t) e^{\cos(t)} \right]\ dt \\ & = \left[ e^{2 \sin(t)} + e^{\cos(t)} \right]_0^{\pi/2} = e (e -1).\end{align*}$

source_text: Example 2

source_text: The work done by a force $latex \vec F$ along the path $latex \mathcal C$ is given by $latex W = \int_{\mathcal C} \vec F \cdot d\vec r$. If $latex \vec r$ moves according to Newton's law, $latex \vec F = m \ d^2 \vec r / d t^2$, so that
target_text: Usaha yang dilakukan oleh gaya $latex \vec F$ di sepanjang lintasan $latex \mathcal C$ diberikan oleh $latex W = \int_{\mathcal C} \vec F \cdot d\vec r$. Jika $latex \vec r$ bergerak menurut hukum Newton, $latex \vec F = m \ d^2 \vec r / d t^2$, maka

source_text: $latex \displaystyle W = \int_{t_0}^{t_1} m\ \frac{d^2 \vec r}{d t^2} \cdot \frac{d \vec r}{d t}\ dt = \left[\frac{1}{2} m \left(\frac{d \vec r}{d t}\right)^2 \right]_{t_0}^{t_1} = \left[ \frac{1}{2} m v^2 \right]_{t_0}^{t_1},$
target_text: $latex \displaystyle W = \int_{t_0}^{t_1} m\ \frac{d^2 \vec r}{d t^2} \cdot \frac{d \vec r}{d t}\ dt = \left[\frac{1}{2} m \left\|\frac{d \vec r}{d t}\right\|^2 \right]_{t_0}^{t_1} = \left[ \frac{1}{2} m v^2 \right]_{t_0}^{t_1},$

source_text: i.e. the work done by $latex \vec F$ as a point mass moves along the path $latex \mathcal C$ is equal to the difference in kinetic energy of the point mass between the end points of $latex \mathcal C$.

Dalam rumus berikut, $latex B_\varepsilon(P)$ adalah bola berpusat di titik itu dengan jari-jari epsilon; $latex \partial B_\varepsilon(P)$ adalah permukaannya; dan $latex \vec n$ adalah vektor normal satuan ke luar. target_text: Perhatikan aliran $latex \vec v(\vec r)$ suatu fluida dengan kerapatan $latex \rho(\vec r,t)$. Misalkan $latex V$ adalah suatu daerah tetap dalam domain fluida. Massa fluida di dalam $latex V$ diberikan oleh $latex \displaystyle m = \int_V \rho dV$, dan laju perubahannya adalah

source_text: $latex \displaystyle \frac{d m}{d t} = \int_V \frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t}\ dV,$
